scope_notes: The RFP's 19 printed position-list bullets map to 26 pay-table rows. Several pay-table rows contain multiple career levels sharing one published grade.

The FY27 authorization identifies 122 Fire & Rescue and 153 Police FTE. The RFP narrative separately states 112 fire personnel and 121 sworn police officers; its printed position list also includes communications and a civilian investigator.

Police Chief and Police Sergeant appear in the published authorization but are absent from the RFP's printed covered-position list. Preserve them as context and clarify study coverage through the prime's single Town inquiry.

The Fire & Rescue pay table includes Emergency Management Coordinator I, II, while the authorization places this position under Administration. It is retained as pay-table context and excluded from the Fire & Rescue authorized-position cohort.
Police Senior Program Support Specialist has a PT 30 pay-title annotation but 1 FT / 1 FTE in the authorization. The original conflict remains visible in its mapping note.

The 86-officer, 54-firefighter, 24-captain and 10-telecommunicator buckets do not disclose their allocation among grades. Editable allocations must sum to the original group total before they can become a planning cohort.
